notes:
ACCESS: Claude-in-Chrome only, own tab, no HTTP-layer tooling. robots.txt read in-tab: generic 'User-agent: *' group only, no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web/Claude-User/Claude-SearchBot rule and no Claude-specific Disallow; 13 locale sitemaps listed. Worked the da-dk locale (matches assigned country Denmark). Root https://www.georgjensen.com/ is a locale-neutral shell; https://www.georgjensen.com/da-dk/ is the real storefront. Platform is Salesforce Commerce Cloud (Demandware); the ?start=0&sz=N listing pattern and the 'Viser N af N' header both work. No block, 403, CAPTCHA or rate-limit encountered at any point. (One javascript_tool result came back '[BLOCKED: Cookie/query string data]' - that is the MCP connector's own output redaction filter, not a site block; the same query re-ran cleanly once query strings were stripped from the collected hrefs.)

RESULT: NO FURNITURE. Georg Jensen is a Danish silversmith/jewellery house; its non-jewellery catalogue is candle holders, vases, bowls, picture frames, clocks, tableware, cutlery and hollowware. Absence was earned four independent ways:

(1) RENDERED NAVIGATION. The da-dk homepage serves its full mega-menu server-side: 213 unique in-locale nav links parsed out of the delivered document. Exactly five shopping departments exist - Smykker (Jewellery), Ure (Watches), Bolig (Home), Til bordet (For the Table), Soelvhaandvaerk (Silver craftsmanship). There is no Moebler / Furniture department and no room-based department (no Stue/Living, Sovevaerelse/Bedroom, Kontor/Office, Have/Garden). Full Bolig menu: Nyheder, Lysestager (candle holders), Vaser & plantepotter, Vaegure og vejrstationer (wall clocks/weather stations), Skaale (bowls), Bonbonnierer, Bordlamper (table lamps), Billedrammer (picture frames), Boeger (books), Accessories, Paaskepynt, Julepynt, Reservedele, Udendoers (outdoor), Til boern, plus designer/collection nodes (Koppel, Bernadotte, Cobra, Bloom, Alfredo, Elephant, Nendo, Panton, Chrome Contours, Heart, Terra, Frequency, Ilse, Lituus, Maria Berntsen, design-icons). None is furniture.

(2) CATEGORY SITEMAP. Fetched /da-dk/sitemap_0.xml same-origin from the loaded page: 2299 URLs = 2063 product-detail pages (.html) + 236 category/content URLs. Of those 236, 111 sit in the three home-side departments (bolig 31, til-bordet 32, soelvhaandvaerk 31, shop 3, dining-and-bar 2, explore 11). A furniture-slug scan over the whole category set in ENGLISH (furniture, sofa, chair, table, bench, bed, desk, cabinet, wardrobe, stool, dresser, shelving, bookcase, seating, sideboard, ottoman, pouf, daybed) and in DANISH (moebler/moebel, stole, borde, baenke, hylder, reoler, skabe, puffer, seng/senge, kommode, garderobe, taburet, laenestol, natbord, skrivebord, spisebord, sofabord, sofa, udendoers, have) returned no furniture node. The only Danish-keyword hits were false friends: 'til-bordet' = for-the-table (tableware department, not tables), 'borddaekning' = table setting, 'skaale-fade-bakker' = bowls/platters/trays, and 'skrivebord-kommode' - inspected below.

(3) DEPARTMENT TILE STRIPS (the SR 142 / Soestrene Grene trap). Each department has its own 'Se alle' all-categories page that is NOT in the sitemap: /da-dk/bolig/kategorier (h1 'Alt til hjemmet'), /da-dk/til-bordet/kategorier and /da-dk/soelvhaandvaerk/kategorier. All three were fetched and every in-locale link on them was diffed against the union of (mega-menu 213 + sitemap 236). New categories exposed by these tile pages: ZERO. So unlike Soestrene Grene, this mega-menu does not under-report the tree - nav, sitemap and department tile strips agree exactly.

(4) PRODUCT-LEVEL SCAN. The 2063 product URLs reduce to 724 unique product slugs (Danish product names). A deliberately loose substring scan for stol|bord|baenk|hylde|reol|skab|puf|sofa|seng|kommode|moebl|chair|table|bench|shelf|cabinet|desk|dresser|wardrobe|bookcase|stool|bed produced only 3 hits across the entire catalogue, all false positives: 'sky-bordkortholdere-4-stk' and 'bernadotte-bordkortholdere-4-stk' (bordkortholder = place-card holder) plus the 'til-bordet' department slug itself. There is not one furniture product in the Danish catalogue.

EXCEPTIONS OPENED AND SETTLED ON PRODUCT EVIDENCE (per the rule that a keyword scan generates candidates, never classifications):
- /da-dk/soelvhaandvaerk/skrivebord-kommode, menu label 'Til skrivebordet og kommoden', h1 'Skrivebord og kommode' (literally 'Desk and Dresser'). This is the one slug on the site that names furniture. Opened it: header 'Viser 26 af 26', and all 26 titles are objects you put ON a desk or dresser - skrin/soelv skrin (silver caskets and boxes) x9, papirkniv (letter openers) x6, pengeclips (money clips) x4, pilleaeske (pill boxes) x2, potpourri krukke, KONGE forstoerrelsesglas (magnifying glass), Stok 116 (walking cane), BERNADOTTE flaskeaabner (bottle opener). No desk, no dresser, no furniture of any kind. Correctly excluded - it is a surface/room theme node, not a furniture node. (Same conclusion the prior Home-Decor pass reached from the other direction.)
- /da-dk/bolig/udendoers, h1 'Udendoers indretning' (Outdoor). Only plausible route to garden furniture. Opened it: header 'Viser 8 af 8', all 8 are hurricane lanterns and candle holders plus replacement glass - CHROME CONTOURS lanterns x4, KOPPEL hurricane lysestage, and 3 RESERVEDEL (spare glass) items. No outdoor tables, chairs, benches or loungers. Correctly excluded.
- /da-dk/til-bordet/koekkenmaskiner (kitchen machines) = small appliances, out of scope. /da-dk/bolig/bordlamper = table lamps, lighting, excluded. /da-dk/bolig/vaegure = wall clocks, excluded. Jewellery (smykker, 50 category URLs) and watches (ure, 8) were not traversed - no furniture can live there.

SITE SEARCH WAS DELIBERATELY NOT USED as the absence test, per the brief's warning that a search returning 0 proves nothing. The sitemap-plus-product-slug enumeration above is a full-catalogue title scan and is strictly stronger evidence.
